transfer.method: Stream the original tar archive; retain compiled classes and non-native resources; omit packaged JARs and native libraries. Repack at gzip level 1. Normal Maven test lifecycle regenerates packages and copies the separately downloaded current native artifact.
transfer.limits: Artifact-size comparison, not whole-CI timing. Fresh-consumer resource and reactor regressions pass locally on JDK 11 and 17. Hosted qualification remains required.

initial_worker_attribution.limits: Initial local attribution without metadata archives, using the existing development native library. Instrumented elapsed time is not a speedup measurement. Compiler events used the default profile threshold; no compiler activity events were recorded. Java/native samples and concurrent waits are not exact CPU attribution. This does not qualify the complete CI inventory.

lazy_parent_cluster.method: Three alternating eager/lazy pairs on the same local machine, fresh Surefire JVMs, identical invocation multisets and outcome counts. All modes use first-tier compilation and a 512 MiB code cache. Unit/operator selection has four fresh 2 GiB forks; canonical selection has one 1 GiB fork and two prepared metadata archives shared across both modes.
lazy_parent_cluster.limits: Selected local workloads, not a whole-CI speedup. The baseline explicitly sets sf.test.lazyCluster=false. The new default defers initialization until an execution-environment lookup; native leak checks, memory budgets and session/class cleanup remain active. Linux cohort validation remains required.

flink18_jdk11.failure_reason: Existing metadata archive control: local macOS JDK 11 reports Shared spaces are not supported in this VM. Lifecycle, operator and SQL controls pass.

hosted_validation.retry: Three initial jobs failed on HTTP 502 in the producer jobs API before test execution. Rerunning only those failed jobs passed; the successful first-attempt cohort was retained.

queue_baseline.method: Use completed successful job intervals and actual first-step start times. Canonical eligibility is completion of all four required preparation jobs. Sweep execution intervals for peak overlapping CI jobs.
queue_baseline.limits: Observed overlap within this CI run, not an account quota declaration. Eligibility-to-start delay includes scheduler/runner waiting; it does not identify which other campaign or scheduler policy caused a delay.

native_payload_probe.method: GNU binutils 2.39 in a temporary Linux amd64 Alpine container; compare original, strip-debug and strip-unneeded copies. Verify ELF machine remains x86-64 and every allocated section including dynamic symbol/string tables retains identical type, flags, virtual address, size and content. Sum independent raw DEFLATE level-1 stream sizes for each library.
native_payload_probe.decision: Prototype only. Prefer debug-only stripping to retain static function names. Preserve the original full-symbol artifact for diagnostics; test consumers can use separate smaller payloads. Canonical Kafka source/sink fixtures use JSON, requiring core, JSON and Kafka libraries.
native_payload_probe.limits: Offline file-size and allocated-section equivalence checks; no loaded JNI test against stripped copies yet. Deflate totals exclude ZIP container headers. No whole-CI timing claim.

real_staging_validation.status: offline staging validated; hosted JNI validation pending
